name: ClickUp
summary: ClickUp has a free plan with unlimited tasks and free members. Core costs $9 per user a month billed yearly, and Business costs $17. Board and list views are on every plan, while the timeline view needs Business and SAML sign-in needs Enterprise.

facts.text: Board, List, Calendar and Table views are on every plan including Free, while Gantt charts are included from Core.
The Timeline view is included from Business and shown as a trial on the Free and Core plans.
The Free Forever plan caps file storage at 60 MB, with 5 Spaces, 100 automation actions a month and 5 active automation rules.
Google sign-in is listed from Business, and Microsoft, Okta and SAML sign-in from Enterprise.
